predecessors.name: Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic
predecessors.text: the Estonian lands of the former Russian Empire (the page: 'the Estonian Salvation Committee declared the independence of Estonia' on 24 February 1918)

successors.name: Estonian Soviet Socialist Republic
successors.text: annexed 'by the Soviet Union as the Estonian SSR' on 6 August 1940

ledger.x: 1918, 19 November: the Germans hand power back to the Estonian government (the page: they had to 'return power to the Estonian government on 19 November 1918').
1920, 3 January: the ceasefire takes effect ('the peace treaty was concluded on 31 December 1919 and the ceasefire took effect on 3 January 1920'); the Treaty of Tartu follows on 2 February 1920.
1920, 2 February: the Treaty of Tartu fixes the border.

1940, 16 June: the Soviet Union occupies Estonia after the ultimatum of 16 June ('On 16 June 1940 the Soviets issued an ultimatum'); the Estonia page has the Red Army in 'the next day', 17 June, and dates a blockade to 14 June.
1940, 6 August: 'Estonia was annexed by the Soviet Union as the Estonian SSR.'
1940, 6 August: the occupation ends in annexation (the infobox gives the end of the occupation period as 6 August 1940).
1940, 6 August: the republic ends in law and in fact; the West did not recognise the annexation and the government in exile 'was the government recognized by the Western world during the Cold War'.

wars.name: Estonian War of Independence
wars.outcome: Soviet attack on Narva 28 November 1918; ceasefire 3 January 1920; Treaty of Tartu 2 February 1920 on a frontier that 'corresponded roughly with the position of the front line'.

wars.name: Estonian war against the Baltische Landeswehr
wars.outcome: The war 'broke out on the southern front in Latvia on 5 June 1919'; the Estonian 3rd Division recaptured Cesis on 23 June; ceasefire on 3 July 1919 with the Estonians at the outskirts of Riga.

wars.name: Soviet ultimatum and occupation of 1940
wars.outcome: Mutual assistance treaty with Soviet bases on 28 September 1939; ultimatum of 16 June 1940; annexation as the Estonian SSR on 6 August 1940.

certainty.note: German occupation, the Soviet invasion and the Estonian advances moved the front within the year; no treaty line yet.
The Tartu border of 2 February 1920 (frontier follows the front line); the Valga/Valka line with Latvia is not on the pages opened.
